mechanism.claim: A completed hourly Binance perpetual-versus-spot basis residual crossing its causal seven-day center identifies a change in which venue is paying for immediacy. During elevated BTC variation, an unusually large crossing should relay in the new leveraged-demand direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the new hourly mean log-basis residual

external_basis.perpetual_mechanics: He, Manela, Ross and von Wachter, Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures (arXiv:2212.06888)
external_basis.claim_used: funding and arbitrage tether perpetuals to spot while demand shocks create basis deviations
external_basis.adaptation: causal hourly basis-center crossing and BTC high-variation gate are transparent unfitted implementation choices

mechanism.why_distinct: HVCBR ranks the final-two-hour basis change at three daily boundaries and trades convergence. HVCBFC ranks lagged spot-return to next-basis-change correlation and follows the eight-hour spot return. Premium candidates use the exchange premium-index candle. HVBSRT uses the sign transition of the directly aligned one-hour mean cash-perpetual price basis relative to its own strictly prior seven-day median, with no endpoint basis change, lead correlation, premium-index input, prior event set or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed prior-24h BTC variation must occupy its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fresh endogenous cash-perpetual basis regime transitions with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9

features.aligned_hour: 60 exact timestamp-aligned coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance and bars_binance_spot one-minute rows [H-1h,H)
features.hourly_basis: arithmetic mean of 60 minute log bases, finite strict nonzero
features.causal_center: median hourly basis over the 168 exact source-valid hours ending strictly before [H-1h,H); minimum 144; current hour excluded
features.basis_residual: hourly_basis minus causal center, finite strict nonzero
features.transition: current residual sign differs from immediately previous consecutive source-valid hourly residual sign; missing previous rejects
features.residual_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute residual over at most 2160 earlier source-valid hours, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute open-to-close log returns over [H-24h,H)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2160 earlier source-valid hours, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: H after all completed source rows
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, center, transition, history, rank, variation, side, delay, hold, clock, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
